question: who is president of india
answer: Droupadi Murmu is the 15th President of India. She was born on June 20, 1958, in Mayurbhanj district of Odisha. She is a former Governor of Jharkhand and a former Chairperson of the Eastern Zonal Council. Murmu was elected as the President of India on July 21, 2022, and took office on July 25, 2022.
